review.proofing.spelling-grammar.note: U:quill/spelling: opens the Editor pane (panes/editor.tsx) on the next misspelt word after the caret (review.spelling, F7): the word in its sentence, the suggestions, Change, Change All, Ignore Once, Ignore All, Add to Dictionary and Recheck Document. Spelling only and US English only: the app bundles the en_US dictionary (nspell over dictionary-en, core/common/lib/spelling.mjs) and has no grammar engine, so grammar issues are never reported. Text marked with another language, or Do not check spelling, is left out.
